dsh-web-search-firecrawl is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d0d815476c4cddfb761c.html
